title: Circular construction: arithmetic sensitivity calculations
status: NOT a simulation, structural proof, design specification or schedule forecast

catalog_input.source_title: British Steel Product Range, section 3.1 UK Sections
catalog_input.scope: Catalog mass only; no section selection or adequacy claim.

provenance.scenario_inputs: All lengths, robot values, offsets, operation counts, cycle times, utilization, logistics capacities, mean member mass, critical-path duration, retention and event probabilities are hypothetical inputs. They are not measurements or quantities from a designed building.

assumptions_and_limitations: No building floor area, building height, member design, site or assembly plan is implied.

Beam examples are uniform and horizontal; self-weight only, no fittings or payloads. One-end holding assumes an ideal moment-resisting support. Two-support reactions assume supports exactly at the two endpoints; the cases are alternatives.

Anchor wrench is aggregate static external gravity demand only. No contact-force distribution, friction, force closure, actuator limits, anchor capacity, stiffness, buckling, wind, dynamics, tool loads, safety factors or partial-frame stability is tested.

Throughput treats each cell of two climbers as one placement server. A cycle completes one member including both ends; it is not a per-bolt or per-robot cycle. Logistics equipment is additional and has no assumed fleet count here.

T >= max(N*c/(60*cells*u), N/member_supply, N*mean_mass/(1000*mass_supply), critical_path). This optimistic bound assumes effective overlap, steady supply and available work fronts. Queueing, precedence-resource interactions, start-up, weather, recovery and other non-overlapping work can increase elapsed time.
Supply rates and utilization are averages over the same elapsed-time horizon. Days mean continuous 24-hour days. The 72-hour critical path is assumed, not computed.
The throughput mean mass of 100 kg is independent of the illustrative UB beam masses.
Improved supply alone leaves the 40-cell 12-minute case work-limited at 76.923 hours. Only the separate 48-cell sensitivity becomes critical-path-limited at 72 hours.
Retention compounds a fixed per-cycle fraction of original stock, with no top-up. It does not estimate actual reuse yield or ecological regeneration.

Event calculations assume independent identical per-task unresolved-event probabilities. An unresolved event is not automatically a structural failure. Correlations, recovery, duration and severity are unmodeled; probabilities are not observed reliability data.

robot_plus_6m_beam_aggregate_gravity_wre.interpretation: Net gravity wrench only; aggregate reactions must balance it. This does not allocate loads to anchors or test their feasibility. The 1 m beam offset is an assumed COM location relative to the anchor reference, not a claim that its COM is 1 m from a beam end.

throughput_sensitivities.additional_assumption: Cell count increased from 40 to 48; unvalidated sensitivity only.

work_capacity_only_reference.scope: Separate abstract operations example; omits supply and critical-path bounds.
